title: Tai Tham, New Tai Lue, Tai Le & Cham

metadata.author: pdfnative-cli samples
metadata.subject: Four scripts shaped by the Universal Shaping Engine (pdfnative 1.8.0) — demonstration content
metadata.keywords: tai tham, new tai lue, tai le, cham, universal shaping engine

blocks.text: Rendered with --font nod --font khb --font tdd --font cjm --font latin --lang nod,khb,tdd,cjm,latin. Tai Tham (Lanna) and Cham go through the Universal Shaping Engine, whose cluster grammar comes from Unicode 17.0.0; New Tai Lue and Tai Le are simple scripts with their own fonts. Each code point is routed to the font whose cmap covers it.
ᨲᩫ᩠ᩅᨾᩮᩬᩥᨦ ᨸᩩᨶ ᨻᩱᨬ᩠ᨬ᩠ᨿᨲ᩠ᨲ ᨷᩣᩃᩦ — subjoined consonants (sakot) and pre-base vowels reorder before the base.
ᦎᦸᧈᦑᦸᧈ ᦍᦲᧂ ᦺᦖᧈ ᦵᦋᦲᧉ ᦎᦱᧂᧈ ᦵᦉᦲᦰ — the script of Sipsongpanna Dai.
ᥖᥭᥰ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥐᥩᥴ ᥖᥭᥰ ᥐᥩᥴ — tone letters follow the syllable.
ꨌꩌ ꨭꨌꨯꨱꨭ ꨓꨭꨩꨯꨭ ꨀꨋꨩ ꨟꨩꨮꨭꨩꨯꨭ — Eastern Cham, with medial consonants and final consonants shaped by the engine.
